text:
Maya: Hey infra — can someone take a quick look at PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/data-pipelines/pull/482? It's an additive migration (adds user_tier to accounts) + a backfill job change. Planning to merge and run the backfill tonight if CI is green.

Jonah: pinging DB folks — what's the risk on ALTER TABLE here? table is ~200M rows.

Maya: ALTER is fast (adds nullable column) — no rewrite expected on Postgres 14 since it's a metadata-only add. The backfill is a separate batch job that updates accounts in small segments. I included a circuit-breaker and resume token in the job.

Jonah: ok good. Can you paste the exact SQL you're going to run for the backfill? want to sanity-check locking and batching.

Maya: sure — snippet in PR description.

```sql
-- run in small windows, 5k rows at a time
BEGIN;
UPDATE accounts
SET user_tier = CASE WHEN spending_cents >= 100000 THEN 'pro' ELSE 'free' END
WHERE user_tier IS NULL
AND id IN (
  SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE user_tier IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 5000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
);
COMMIT;
```

Maya: job has exponential backoff and records progress to backfill_state table. If any batch errors, it pauses and alerts.

Lina: quick nit — can we add a safety TTL on backfill_state rows so stale runs don't block? also add an opt-out flag for experimental accounts.

Maya: good call. I added TTL and opt_out column in the job config. pushed new commit.

db-ci-bot: CI: unit tests ✅, integration smoke tests ✅, migration-checker ✅. (run id: 2024-11-02_03).

Alex: LGTM from me on code. Can we get one more DB approval and then schedule the migration at 02:00 UTC? prefer low-traffic window.

Jonah: I can do a quick review now. scanning... looks fine. Two tiny comments on logging verbosity — optional. overall safe to roll. :thumbsup:

Lina: Approve — please coordinate the scheduled run with me and post the start/finish results in #eng-infra.

Maya: Will do. I'll merge once the 10-minute staging backfill completes and then schedule the prod job at 02:00 UTC. I'll ping here when I start.

scheduling-bot: scheduled job 'accounts.user_tier_backfill' for 2024-11-03T02:00:00Z by Maya.

Maya: Thanks all. Merge in 5 after staging validation.

Alex: thanks — leave a note if we need to revert, but plan looks good.

Maya: final: staging backfill succeeded (0 failed batches). merging now.

db-ci-bot: Merge queued by Maya. Merge checks passed.

Maya: (follow-up) after prod backfill runs I'll share a short summary: rows processed, avg batch latency, any retries.

Lina: perfect, thanks for the thoroughness.
